bridge_overhead_hypothesis.interpretation: The persistent boundary removes the measured process path when every matched unit is lower latency. The launch share is reported separately; unisolated child I/O and kernel wait remain in their own residual, so launch is not assumed to explain all subprocess cost.

field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: Empty because this task invokes no LLM.
field_principles.compiled_binding_receipt: Binary hash and loaded module path prove Rust execution.
field_principles.duration_s: Measure monotonic elapsed work; never pad time to pass a floor.
field_principles.e2e_receipts: Binding and serialization round trips must execute.
field_principles.execution_venue: Host or device identity limits the scope of the evidence.
field_principles.field_principles: Echo each declared reason beside the actual evidence contract.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Every blocked verdict names the failed check, upstream, field, expected and observed value.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Use complete_ or complete: for completed findings, including nulls; blocked_* for external blocks. Never promote infrastructure readiness as scientific benefit.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Describe executed computation, not the planned workload.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: Apply the duration floor for the work actually performed.
field_principles.model_invoked: False; upstream inference is cited, not repeated.
field_principles.phase_cost_rows: Measured attribution tests the bridge-overhead explanation.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Record each required resource and its actual observed state.
field_principles.pyo3_slice_ready_score: Readiness requires real compiled binding execution and parity.
field_principles.random_seed: Freeze all stochastic choices before reading held-out outcomes.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Hash inputs, code, seeds and raw rows.
field_principles.rows: Retain unit ID, arm, seed, metric, error and abstention for every comparison.
field_principles.sample_size_budget: Record planned and completed counts, independent units and exclusions.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Bind code, inputs and frozen contracts to the result.
field_principles.status: Terminal only after completion or a diagnosed external block.
field_principles.transition_rows: Explicit proposals isolate language parity from RNG differences.
field_principles.verdict_class: Use positive | circular_positive | null | blocked | disqualified | partial. Only incomplete own work can be partial.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: True when verification uses the same correctness authority; separate implementations alone do not remove circularity.

honest_verdict: complete: genuine compiled PyO3 execution matched every explicit transition, preserved magnetization and restart state, and passed independent finite-law checks. The measured bridge-overhead hypothesis was supported. This prototype creates no 10x gate and makes no sampler-speed or scientific-benefit claim.
inference_substrate: cpu_exact_solver_or_simulator: compiled persistent PyO3 pair-swap kernel, independent Python control, exact finite-slice law, and retained subprocess phase timings

prior_failures.addressed_by: Replace per-call subprocess serialization with a persistent compiled PyO3 boundary; preserve the same kernel and report speed separately after parity.
prior_failures.verdict: null: compiled Rust matched every explicit Python transition, all independent streams matched the Exp7187 exact law, and the bounded serialized E2E passed, but at least one measured deployment latency speedup was below NFR-01's 10x target. The parity path is ready; the speed result is retained as a performance null.
